text:
I wrote `review.md` with verdict **fix**. It sits in the task folder beside `session.jsonl`. I made no code edits and didn't run the new test.

- **No `requirements.md`:** the task folder doesn't have one, so I couldn't check the change against the owner's words. I could only compare it with the code comment in `ChatV3.js`. A fresh agent can't continue from the folder alone either. I marked this as a [fix].
- **Stale docs:** `ext/Chat/v3/readme.md` (lines 10–11) still says a Prompt's title is its first words, muted. `ext/Chat/readme.md` (line 70) still lists the repeated first-words title as an open item. I marked both as [fix].
- **Notes:** the `sentence_items.length <= 2` rule in `redundant_title` also hides the title of a long two-sentence dictation. The new test doesn't cover that boundary.

I rewrote the proposal's `requirements.md` and logged one "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`.

- **Title:** it now reads "Chat v3: hide a title that repeats its prompt", down from a longer, wordier one.
- **Picture:** I added a small before/after block showing "Hello" over "Hello" becoming a single "Hello" with the reply nested under it.

`text-check` also flagged `review.md` (244 words, no picture). I left it alone because it's a reviewer's note for agents, not something the owner reads.

I did not open the Chat v3 page in a browser.

I rewrote the landed task's outcome as a short ticked checklist, and logged one `rewrote` line in `flags.jsonl`. The text-check now flags only `review.md` (244 words, no picture); I left it, since it is detail one click down.

- **Problem:** the old outcome was a 135-word paragraph and ticked none of the owner's asks.
- **Fix:** I appended an `assign` line to `session.jsonl`, since the task has no `task.jsonl`. It now lists four ticked asks with proof, plus one open item (a long two-sentence prompt also loses its title, untested).
- **Screenshot:** I read the existing 1920 shot of the Chat v3 demo page, not a fresh one. It reads clearly, but it doesn't show the "Hello" case, so I couldn't confirm the fix by eye.
- **Owner:** I couldn't call `list_agents`, so I didn't check whether anyone still owns the task. I applied the rewrite myself.
